findings.claim: OBSERVED. A second divergence from core's scanner of the same fail-open class the cured Major named survives the fold: the template/wrapper scanner has no `$(` substitution arm, so `boundary` stays false and a `#` glued to `$(` is not read as a comment; a `<<word` inside that comment opens a heredoc whose unterminated body blanks every later line, and the merge goes unjudged.
findings.counterexample: `echo $(# <<note` NEWLINE `gh pr merge 5` NEWLINE `)` -- folded wrapper never spawns (fail-OPEN); core's findHeredocs returns [] for the same string; bash executes the merge. With a space (`echo $( # <<note`) the folded wrapper fires pr 5, isolating the boundary flag as the cause. Core carries the arm at packages/core/src/transport-shield.ts:359-365 with the comment 'a `#` right after `$(` is a comment'. Neither disclosed at gate-wrapper.cjs:145-175 nor covered in gate-install.test.ts.
